answer: Pay answers by max-flow through a capacity-limited attestation graph, not by headcount. Each established rater receives only three outflow units per epoch; an answer's reward equals the maximum flow from a rotating set of 21 long-lived roots to that answer. A farm that stations a mesa of sockpuppets behind one sponsor cannot move more than that sponsor's three units across the cut. The ledger treats a jetty of cloned keys, and a dune of inbound edges that share one parent, as a single pipe. Extra names past the cut earn nothing, so mass identity spam is wasted capital.
